reconciliation.message: attributed costs plus the unattributed remainder equal the measured total

caveats.message: 3000 of the measured 27008 prompt tokens were served from Anthropic's prompt cache. The cache is shared between sessions, so this is normal for a fresh session and does not change the prompt's size.

this session booted on claude-opus-4-5 and switched to claude-opus-4-7 at 2026-07-01 09:02:00 UTC. The model and window above follow the most recent recorded turn — they describe the session now. The measured first-turn total (the anchor) is not moved by the switch: that request was served by claude-opus-4-5, and it is still the request the anchor measures.

the measured total covers the whole first request, so the unattributed remainder also contains this session's first typed message (30 characters) alongside the base system prompt and the built-in tool schemas.
